execution_order.title: Create staging Entra groups and assign least-privilege ownership
execution_order.rollback: Remove staging assignments and delete unused staging groups.

execution_order.title: Enforce admin MFA and managed-device Conditional Access in pilot scope
execution_order.rollback: Disable staging pilot policies and re-enable report-only evaluation.

execution_order.title: Publish staging sensitivity labels and DLP policy set
execution_order.rollback: Unpublish staging label policies and disable staging DLP policies.

execution_order.title: Enable Power Automate managed environment and connector governance
execution_order.rollback: Move flows back to sandbox ownership and disable managed-environment controls.

restrictions: no compliance content search by default
no project ownership changes through M365
no Conditional Access or Intune policy editing

allowed_actions: use governed Teams and Outlook actions
access governed collaboration tools on assigned records only

restrictions: no standing guest access until later phases

shared_mailboxes: Department shared mailboxes require two business owners and one security-reviewed access group.
Auto-forwarding to external addresses is disabled.
Shared mailbox use is for collaboration and support routing, not project workflow state.
external_sharing: Allow only Specific People links for approved pilot sites.
Guest sharing requires department lead approval and named external owner justification.
Sharing expiration and review are mandatory for pilot guests.
sensitivity_labels: Publish Internal, Internal Restricted, Client Controlled, and Legal Hold labels in staging.
Admin and reviewer personas must test label visibility and protection behavior before production.
Use staged auto-label simulation before production enforcement.
audit_and_retention: Enable unified audit and advanced audit where licensed.
Retain audit events for admin, sharing, and automation actions long enough to validate rollout.
Define who reviews audit exceptions weekly.
automation_ownership: Power Automate uses a managed environment with connector restrictions and flow owner review.
Every flow needs named business owner, technical owner, and dashboard record reference.
No flow may own workflow state independently of the dashboard.

manual_admin_checklist.step: Create PMC-STG groups and assign owners for platform, security, and department governance.
Enable phishing-resistant MFA for admin pilot users and require compliant devices for admin portals.
Configure staging SharePoint and OneDrive sharing to Specific People with approval-owned guest access.
Publish staging labels, enable pilot DLP, and confirm audit retention coverage.
Create the managed Power Automate environment and enforce connector approval.

validation_checklist: Confirm admin pilot access fails on unmanaged devices.
Confirm shared mailboxes use group-based access and no direct user sprawl.
Confirm staging guests expire and require reapproval.
Confirm every flow has both business and technical ownership and points back to dashboard context.
rollback_principles: Move Conditional Access policies back to report-only before removing group assignments.
Disable DLP and label publication before deleting label definitions.
Disable guest access before removing external collaboration sites.
